construct.constructDefinition: 更常感到直接上级愿意听、帮得上忙或提供与工作有关的反馈。国际英文附录完整维度。仅用于有直属主管的成年工作者的非商业研究。

population.populationNotes: 适用于能读懂英文且已确认属于有直属主管的成年工作者的研究样本。作为非商业研究的自评资料，配有独立中英文反馈。

administration.timeFrame: 依原题所问的当前工作关系。附录未另行规定回顾期。
layoutConstraints: 保留英文原题、题号、原序、响应锚点和计分方向。
平台按完整答卷计算本维度 0–100 原量尺均分。
只纳入事先确认属于有直属主管的成年工作者的非商业研究样本。附录第 20 页将无相应关系作为可选缺失项。本分量表适用于已确认的人群，保留五个原版有分选项。有题未答时，本维度留空。

intendedUses.notes: English item set and scores follow the Annex. Research applicability is exploratory for this exact standalone administration. Studies of a separately administered national form or international Middle subset do not establish benchmarks for this Annex dimension. Use only in a preselected non-commercial research sample of adult workers with an immediate supervisor. Annex 1 footnote † permits adding 'I do not have a supervisor' as a missing response if needed. This edition is restricted to the confirmed cohort, with five original scored responses. An incomplete scale has no score.

items.content: How often is your immediate superior willing to listen to your problems at work, if needed?
How often do you get help and support from your immediate superior, if needed?
How often does your immediate superior talk with you about how well you carry out your work?

scores.label: Social Support from Supervisor
scores.description: 更常感到直接上级愿意听、帮得上忙或提供与工作有关的反馈

interpretations.headline: What is the first conversation when work gets stuck?
interpretations.summary: This result describes how often an immediate supervisor listens, provides help or gives feedback about how the work is being carried out.

guidance.text: Pick a common sticking point and agree when to ask, what kind of support would help and when to check in.

limitations: 本分量表由 3 项构成。各题按原版计分转换到 0–100，完整作答后等权求均分。分数越高，表示更常感到直接上级愿意听、帮得上忙或提供与工作有关的反馈。
只纳入事先确认属于有直属主管的成年工作者的非商业研究样本。附录第 20 页将无相应关系作为可选缺失项。本分量表适用于已确认的人群，保留五个原版有分选项。有题未答时，本维度留空。
本次分数用于描述作答。未套用当地常模、等级或筛选界值。
